positions.title: Founder, Growth Engineering
positions.description:
Started my own freelance agency to help early stage startups with product led growth.
I worked with OfficeHours (CRV, Susa Ventures), Commonstock (Floodgate, Coatue, acq. by Yahoo finance), Sunnyside (Motley Fool Ventures), and a few others.

positions.title: Head of Engineering
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth
positions.description:
Helping Quizlet's 50 million monthly users in 130 countries create over 300 million study sets

Engineering Project Lead for:
- Student Onboarding
- Teacher Onboarding
- Aha Moments
- Set up moments
- Sign up/login optimization

Acquisition projects:
- Word of Mouth optimization
- Referral program
- Viral coefficient optimization: sharing + inviting
- Google/FB/Snap ad pixels

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
YC 2013, Union Square Ventures, Canvas Ventures

Worked on multiple aspects of the Growth funnel:
- Activation (sign up optimization, aha moment, setup moment, onboarding)
- Engagement (core engagement loop)
- Resurrection - created first resurrection project for churned users
- helped establish growth culture (ICE prioritization framework)
- Data analysis
- experiment design and ideation

Acquisition work:
- Physical goods outreach campaign
- Landing pages for ad campaigns

Other:
- user interviews
- member of small team that rewrote entire application from the ground up

Full Stack Engineer on Apps team: MongoDB, Firebase, Express, AngularJS, Angular 5, Node

volunteerExperiences.description: At Duke, I taught the SAT to high-achieving, Durham high school students on Saturday mornings
